title: Redundancy and measurement-error replacement questions
caption: Analytical population PFI for the used indicator and the joint block under four declared Gaussian reliability settings. Independent marginal replacement, true conditional replacement, and joint replacement preserve different quantities. Unused-indicator PFI is zero and retained in the results table. Monte Carlo estimates and standard errors independently verify the displayed analytic values; no confidence interval is displayed.
